svg.text: shuffling and batching — the same 24 images, two different epochs
one batch = 64 images → one forward, one backward, one optimizer step
one epoch = 31 batches = every image seen once (2000 ÷ 64 = 31 remainder 16)
30 epochs = 930 optimizer steps, and the order is redrawn every epoch
the leftover 16 are dropped each epoch — but shuffling means they are different 16 every time
